stories.title: Sensex adds 1,213 points in two days as Nifty tops 23,000
stories.summary: The Sensex added 308 points on Friday to 74,459, building on Thursday's 905 point rise for a two day gain of 1,213 points, and the Nifty reclaimed 23,000. This happened with crude at $117 a barrel, no end in sight to the US-Iran war and weak global markets.

stories.title: Rupee gains 33 paise to close at 94.93
stories.summary: The rupee rose 33 paise to close at 94.93 against the dollar on Friday, after opening at 95.21, as the greenback stayed soft and an upbeat Dalal Street lent support. Elevated crude prices and weakness in broader markets limited the gains.

stories.title: Indian bonds fall for a fourth straight month on oil
stories.summary: The benchmark 6.94% 2036 bond yield rose 2.5 basis points to 7.4139 per cent on Friday and climbed 22.5 basis points in October, a fourth straight monthly loss for bonds. Brent crude is up nearly 14 per cent this month, which matters for the world's third largest oil importer.

stories.title: Retail investors borrowed Rs 2,228 crore to buy Jio on debut
stories.summary: Indian retail investors borrowed Rs 2,228 crore, about $234 million, through margin funding to buy Jio Platforms shares on its listing day. This came weeks after a wave of margin call liquidations cut the market's margin trading book to Rs 1.51 trillion from a record Rs 1.59 trillion.

stories.title: Eternal nears a record high on Blinkit optimism
stories.summary: Eternal shares hit a 52 week high of Rs 345.65 on Friday, passing the previous high of Rs 344.75 from 23 September, on optimism about growth at Blinkit. The Zomato and Blinkit parent has gained 13 per cent in six trading days since its September quarter results.

stories.title: Vedanta Oil and Gas jumps 18% after swinging to profit
stories.summary: Vedanta Oil and Gas shares rose as much as 18 per cent to Rs 32.90 on Friday after it reported a Rs 746 crore second quarter profit, against a Rs 152 crore loss in the June quarter. Higher oil prices offset a fall in production.

stories.title: Suzlon falls 8% as margins miss expectations
stories.summary: Suzlon Energy shares fell 8.3 per cent to Rs 33.23 intraday on Friday, after second quarter results missed margin expectations. Revenue from operations rose 26 per cent to Rs 4,869 crore on record quarterly deliveries of 710 MW. The Nifty 50 was up 0.65 per cent at the time.

stories.title: IndiGo shares rise 4% despite a third straight loss
stories.summary: IndiGo shares settled 4.33 per cent higher at Rs 4,877 on Friday after a third consecutive quarterly loss. Revenue grew 26 per cent to Rs 23,360 crore on a 34 per cent rise in passenger yield, while fuel expenses rose 67 per cent. Investors chose to look at the fares.

stories.title: Atomberg gets SEBI approval for its IPO
stories.summary: Atomberg Technologies has received SEBI approval for an IPO comprising a fresh issue of up to Rs 450 crore and an offer for sale of 76,542,051 shares. It plans to use Rs 90 crore to repay borrowings and Rs 150 crore for brand awareness and performance marketing.

stories.title: Ratnadeep Retail gets SEBI nod for its IPO
stories.summary: Hyderabad based grocery retailer Ratnadeep Retail has received SEBI approval for an IPO with a fresh issue of up to Rs 400 crore and an offer for sale of up to 1.49 crore shares by promoter selling shareholders. The approval appeared on SEBI's website on Friday.

stories.title: Asian Paints holds steady as brokerages trim targets
stories.summary: Asian Paints shares traded largely flat after standalone net profit rose 14.6 per cent to Rs 1,095.6 crore and revenue 14.8 per cent to Rs 8,423.6 crore. Margins contracted on raw material inflation and supply constraints. It declared an interim dividend of Rs 5.75 a share.

stories.title: Jefferies sees NSE gold receipts earning Rs 1,260 crore by FY30
stories.summary: NSE could earn nearly Rs 1,260 crore a year from electronic gold receipts by FY30 Jefferies estimates, assuming trading volumes of 18,750 tonnes, 25 times India's annual gold consumption. The forecast relies on India trading gold far more than it wears it.

stories.title: Jio Financial promoter holding rises to 50.98%
stories.summary: Jio Financial Services allotted 12.5 crore shares each to promoter group entities Sikka Ports and Terminals and Jamnagar Utilities and Power by converting their remaining warrants, at a premium of Rs 306.50 a share. The promoter holding rises to 50.98 per cent.

stories.title: Wall Street has its worst day since June on AI spending fears
stories.summary: The Nasdaq fell more than 3.8 per cent and the S&P 500 2.5 per cent on Friday, their worst day since June, as tech earnings revived doubts over AI spending returns. The Dow fell 770 points. A few weeks ago the Nasdaq and S&P 500 were at record highs.

stories.title: US bonds head for their best month in nearly three years
stories.summary: Global tech shares slumped on Friday and US bonds surged toward their biggest monthly gain in nearly three years, as investors moved to safety over worries that huge AI spending may not deliver sufficient returns. Crypto slid after the Binance hack and oil rose on Strait of Hormuz risks.

stories.title: Amazon falls 6% after spending $77 billion in a quarter
stories.summary: Amazon shares fell after it spent more than $77 billion on property and equipment in the third quarter, far above estimates, and reported its slowest core e-commerce growth in three years. Revenue rose 12 per cent to $201.9 billion. Holiday sales guidance of $240 to $247 billion straddled analysts' forecasts.

stories.title: Alphabet loses about $480 billion in value in a day
stories.summary: Alphabet shares fell more than 12 percent on Thursday after disappointing results, wiping around $480 billion off its market value. The European Central Bank left rates unchanged, and the euro dipped after Christine Lagarde announced she will step down as ECB president in February, then recovered.

stories.title: Bank of Japan says it has reached 2% inflation after 13 years
stories.summary: The Bank of Japan said underlying consumer price inflation has reached a level broadly consistent with its 2 per cent target and is expected to stay there. Japan introduced the target in 2013 to end a long period of falling prices. The target took 13 years to arrive.

stories.title: Nasdaq sinks as Amazon and Intel fuel AI spending fears
stories.summary: The Nasdaq Composite fell 2.21 per cent to 25,606.33 in early Friday trade and the S&P 500 1.22 per cent, as investors scrutinised Big Tech's spending, increasingly financed with debt. Intel fell more than 30 per cent, on track for its worst day on record.

stories.title: Gold slips below $4,000 on Fed hike bets
stories.summary: Spot gold fell 0.9 per cent to $3,982.85 an ounce on Friday as higher oil prices and robust US inflation data strengthened the case for another Federal Reserve rate hike. Bullion was headed for a weekly fall and a second straight monthly decline.

stories.title: Bitcoin hits a six-week low after the Binance hack
stories.summary: Bitcoin fell to $77,646 on Friday and Ether to a two month low of $2,239, while BNB dropped more than 8 per cent to $694. Binance said its initial probe found the breach may have come through a DevOps engineer's hacked laptop, which let an attacker submit unauthorised withdrawals.

stories.title: Hackers take $6.3 billion from Binance
stories.summary: North Korean hackers stole $6.3 billion from Binance, the world's largest crypto exchange, in what Finextra describes as the world's largest crypto heist, an attack that could undermine confidence in digital assets. The full piece is for subscribers.

stories.title: Capri jumps 16% while the rest of Wall Street falls
stories.summary: Capri Holdings, owner of Michael Kors and Jimmy Choo, rose nearly 16 per cent on Friday after beating profit estimates and raising its outlook. Revenue fell 5.5 per cent to $809 million, but fewer discounts lifted gross margin to 63.3 per cent. Selling less, for more, worked.

stories.title: Seoul stocks fall 3.85% at the open on AI worries
stories.summary: South Korea's KOSPI fell 3.85 per cent to 5,709.23 early on Friday, tracking Wall Street losses on renewed concerns over the AI boom. The index had already fallen 1.24 per cent the previous session on profit taking in chip stocks, despite record quarterly earnings at Samsung Electronics.

stories.title: Government sets up a banking reform panel under Suresh N Patel
stories.summary: The government has set up a committee chaired by former Central Vigilance Commissioner Suresh N Patel, with RBI Deputy Governor Shirish Chandra Murmu among its members, to recommend changes that make Indian banks more globally competitive, inclusive and resilient. It has six months to report.

stories.title: Supreme Court wants banks to compensate cyber fraud victims
stories.summary: A Supreme Court bench headed by Chief Justice Surya Kant said RBI's proposed framework must include a mandatory clause requiring compensation of at least the amount lost where fraud results from a financial institution's failure to exercise due diligence.

stories.title: RBI asks banks to prove their cybersecurity compliance
stories.summary: RBI has asked lenders to demonstrate compliance with security requirements, investigate fintech system vulnerabilities and explain how they are preparing for AI related threats. It follows incidents including a suspected customer data leak at SBI and unauthorised transfers of about $2 million from two Mumbai non-bank lenders.

stories.title: AU Small Finance Bank probes a likely data breach
stories.summary: AU Small Finance Bank is investigating a potential breach of "limited data" on its vehicle loan customers, hosted on a third party platform operated by Salesforce. The lender did not disclose what information was exposed, how many customers were affected or whether there was any financial impact.

stories.title: SEBI's trainer portal hit by a code execution attack
stories.summary: SEBI confirmed a code execution attack on its Securities Market Trainers portal on 26 October, which is used to empanel trainers for investor awareness programmes. "The execution was detected by Sebi's cybersecurity system and remedial actions were taken," the regulator told Business Standard.

stories.title: SEBI fines CDSL Rs 1 crore over compliance lapses
stories.summary: SEBI fined CDSL Rs 1 crore for lapses including not telling depository participants why pledge requests were rejected, and shortcomings in cybersecurity controls, vulnerability patching and disaster recovery drills. It has been a busy week for cybersecurity findings in Indian finance.

stories.title: Loans against fixed deposits jump 53% on an FCNR-B leverage play
stories.summary: Bank loans against fixed deposits rose 53 per cent to Rs 2.17 lakh crore, against 14.3 per cent growth a year earlier. Overseas customers pledged FCNR-B deposits to borrow a multiple in foreign currency and put it into another FCNR-B deposit, under RBI's dollar mobilisation schemes.

stories.title: Bank of Baroda's FCNR(B) deposits rise nearly sixfold
stories.summary: Bank of Baroda's FCNR(B) deposits rose to Rs 1.03 lakh crore from Rs 29,090 crore at the end of June, with Rs 77,270 crore from its BOB Legend product. Global deposits rose 16.4 per cent to Rs 17.45 lakh crore by 30 September.

stories.title: PSU banks cut fresh deposit rates faster than private lenders
stories.summary: Public sector banks cut fresh deposit rates more sharply than private lenders in September, RBI data showed, but still paid 34 basis points more on fresh deposits and charged 126 basis points less on fresh loans. The system's average lending rate on fresh loans fell to 8.51 per cent.

stories.title: Bank credit grows 17.94%, ahead of deposits
stories.summary: Bank credit rose 17.94 per cent to Rs 232.54 lakh crore by 15 October, RBI data show, while deposits grew 16.60 per cent to Rs 284.37 lakh crore. Buoyant liquidity in early October and festive demand drove the faster lending.

stories.title: Companies need 15% to 20% more working capital, banks say
stories.summary: Mid and large companies' working capital needs have risen 12 to 15 per cent, and as much as 20 per cent in some cases, as higher oil linked costs and longer transit times stretch cash cycles. Kotak Mahindra Bank's Anu Aggarwal said the West Asia conflict has elongated these cycles.

stories.title: Ujjivan Small Finance Bank profit nearly triples
stories.summary: Ujjivan Small Finance Bank reported second quarter profit after tax of about Rs 365 crore, almost three times the year earlier figure, as improving loan quality and controlled credit costs helped. Deposits crossed the Rs 50,000 crore mark during the quarter.

stories.title: Suryoday Small Finance Bank's half-year profit rises 131%
stories.summary: Suryoday Small Finance Bank's first half profit after tax rose 131 per cent to Rs 151.7 crore, and gross advances grew 34.6 per cent to Rs 14,972 crore. Second quarter profit rose to Rs 76.5 crore from Rs 30.4 crore.

stories.title: Health insurers ask IRDAI to tweak expense caps
stories.summary: Health insurers have asked IRDAI to change proposed expenses of management rules. Star Health CFO Nilesh Kambli said mandatory government health and motor third party business involves no intermediary and should be removed from the base for the 25 per cent limit, so the caps reflect actual distribution costs.

stories.title: OPay raises $304 million in its New York IPO
stories.summary: Nigeria focused payments and lending platform OPay raised $304 million in its US IPO, pricing 16 million American depositary shares at $19, the bottom of its range, Reuters reported. Including a concurrent private placement, the offering implies a valuation of about $4 billion.

stories.title: PB Fintech profit rises 43% to Rs 192 crore
stories.summary: PB Fintech, parent of Policybazaar and Paisabazaar, reported a 43 per cent rise in consolidated profit to Rs 192 crore in the second quarter. Total insurance premium rose 38 per cent to Rs 9,385 crore on a 42 per cent rise in new protection premiums.

stories.title: PB Fintech's UAE business looks beyond motor cover
stories.summary: PB Fintech's UAE insurance premium grew 36 per cent in the second quarter, taking its annualised run rate to Rs 2,258 crore. Having set up there in FY19, it now wants to expand into health, life and broader financial products, including cross-border cover for non-resident Indians.

stories.title: Wealthsimple raises C$425 million at a C$13.8 billion valuation
stories.summary: Canadian fintech Wealthsimple agreed an equity round of up to C$425 million at a post-money valuation of C$13.8 billion, led by GIC. It includes a C$300 million primary offering and a secondary sale of up to C$125 million that lets employees cash in part of their holdings.

stories.title: Hyphenate raises $45 million for AI finance agents
stories.summary: Hyphenate, an autonomous finance platform for corporate CFOs, raised $45 million in a Series A led by Nexus Venture Partners, with B Capital joining. The round takes total funding to $54 million and comes less than a month after it rebranded from Maximor. Fresh name, fresh round.

stories.title: PhotonPay raises $40 million to link stablecoins and banks
stories.summary: Hong Kong based PhotonPay raised $40 million in a Series C led by Blockchain Capital, with SBI Group joining as a new investor, to expand infrastructure connecting stablecoins with conventional banking and card networks. It did not disclose its valuation, revenue or a detailed deployment timetable.

stories.title: Coast raises $35 million for fleet payments and expenses
stories.summary: US fintech Coast raised $35 million in growth equity led by Thomvest Ventures, with Intuit Ventures among new investors, to expand its financial management platform for construction, transportation, utilities and other field service businesses. A long list of existing backers, including Accel and ICONIQ Growth, also took part.

stories.title: Ravical raises $17 million so accountants can grow without hiring
stories.summary: Ravical, an AI platform for accounting and tax firms, closed a $17 million seed round led by MMC Ventures to help practices expand without adding staff at the same rate. It plans to deepen its presence in the UK, Belgium, the Netherlands and Germany and launch in the US.

stories.title: CarbonAI raises $12 million to automate property loan underwriting
stories.summary: New York based CarbonAI raised $12 million led by Cowboy Ventures for AI agents that handle commercial real estate lending work, from underwriting and due diligence to investment memos and loan surveillance. The company says it reached seven figures in contracted annual revenue about six months after launch.

stories.title: ECB picks network providers for the digital euro
stories.summary: The European Central Bank has selected two network service providers to connect payment service providers and national central banks to the digital euro service platform, Finextra reported. The full piece is for subscribers.

stories.title: Apple Pay and Google Pay arrive in Uzbekistan
stories.summary: Uzbekistan has announced the arrival of Apple Pay and Google Pay in its banking system as the Central Asian country looks to open up its financial services, Finextra reported. The full piece is for subscribers.

stories.title: Goldman Sachs joins Equilend's DLT lending platform
stories.summary: Securities lending platform Equilend has announced that Goldman Sachs has joined 1Source, its securities finance platform built on distributed ledger technology, according to a report from Finextra. The bank is the latest name on the ledger. The full piece is for subscribers.

stories.title: Kipp acquired by an investor group ahead of a US push
stories.summary: Kipp, a Tel Aviv headquartered fintech platform that connects card issuers and merchants to approve more transactions, has been acquired by an investor group led by LTVCo ahead of a push into the US market, Finextra reported. The full piece is for subscribers.

stories.title: India Post and UTI Mutual Fund extend KYC tie-up
stories.summary: India Post and UTI Mutual Fund have extended their agreement to expand KYC verification services across the country, aiming to make mutual fund access and the KYC process easier, particularly for people in remote and underserved areas. The post office now verifies investors as well as parcels.

stories.title: RBI fraud rule lets scam victims recover up to 85%
stories.summary: From 1 January 2027, victims of small value fraudulent electronic banking transactions can get compensation of up to 85 per cent of the net loss or Rs 25,000, whichever is lower, under an RBI rule. The rule applies only to small value transactions.

stories.title: PNB revises credit card charges from 1 November
stories.summary: Punjab National Bank will revise credit card charges from 1 November, covering cash withdrawals, late payment fees, cheque or auto-debit returns, duplicate statements, reward redemption and utility bill payments. Some services that were free will now carry a charge. The statement will be the first to tell you.

stories.title: Direct mutual fund plans become the default from 1 November
stories.summary: SEBI will make direct mutual fund plans the default on fund houses' digital platforms from 1 November, and investors choosing regular plans will be told about their higher expense ratios, chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey said. Direct plans cost less because they carry no distributor commission.

stories.title: Floating Rate Bond 2034 rate rises to 7.26%
stories.summary: RBI has raised the interest rate on the Government of India Floating Rate Bond 2034 to 7.26 per cent a year for 30 October 2026 to 29 April 2027, up 0.81 percentage points from 6.45 per cent. The bond launched in January 2022.

stories.title: Gold bond from 2019 turns Rs 1 lakh into Rs 3.76 lakh
stories.summary: Investors in SGB 2019-20 Series VI, issued on 30 October 2019, could redeem early on 30 October 2026, RBI said, with Rs 1 lakh invested now worth Rs 3.76 lakh. The price is the average of IBJA's 999 gold closing prices for the preceding three working days.

stories.title: EPFO may consider raising the Rs 1,000 minimum pension
stories.summary: EPFO's Central Board of Trustees is likely to consider the long pending demand to raise the minimum monthly pension of Rs 1,000 under the Employees' Pension Scheme at its 240th meeting, reportedly scheduled for 19 November in Gir, Gujarat. The demand has been pending for years.

stories.title: Dearness relief rises to 63% for central pensioners
stories.summary: The Cabinet raised dearness relief for central government pensioners by 3 percentage points to 63 per cent of basic pension, effective 1 July 2026, alongside the matching DA hike for employees. Eligible family pensioners under the Old Pension Scheme and Unified Pension Scheme also benefit.

stories.title: Gold ETFs or NSE gold receipts: how they differ
stories.summary: Gold ETFs and NSE's electronic gold receipts both let investors own gold exposure without storing metal. A gold ETF gives units in a mutual fund tracking domestic gold prices, while the two differ in structure, trading and redemption, Mint explains with expert views.

stories.title: Your mutual fund may be carrying climate risk
stories.summary: Ten of 12 fund houses improved their scores in the second edition of Risking Alpha, a climate risk assessment by Climate Risk Horizons, even though criteria were applied more strictly than in 2025. The number scoring 10 or more out of 20 rose from three to seven.

stories.title: How home insurance covers accidental fire
stories.summary: The festive season brings a higher risk of accidental home fires from short circuits, firecrackers or unattended diyas and candles, especially when residents are away. Mint explains how home insurance works, what a policy covers in such cases and how to protect a home from fire.

stories.title: Passenger takes IRCTC to court over Rs 1, wins Rs 3,100
stories.summary: A Kerala passenger who got Rs 1 less than due on a cancelled train ticket won his case at the Kasaragod District Consumer Commission. IRCTC must refund the Rs 1, pay Rs 100 compensation and Rs 3,000 in litigation costs. The rupee is back, with friends.

stories.title: Square Yards told to pay Rs 4.25 lakh over a 3D design mismatch
stories.summary: A Hyderabad consumer commission directed Square Yards' interior business and associated entities to pay Rs 4.25 lakh to a Secunderabad customer, after finding discrepancies between the 3D designs she approved and the work done in her flat. It found deficiency in service and unfair trade practices.

research.title: Decomposable Reward Modeling and Realistic Environment Design for Reinforcement Learning-Based Forex Trading
research.summary: Announce Type: replace Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) for foreign exchange (Forex) trading requires realistic execution modeling, interpretable reward design, and action spaces that respect market constraints. Existing approaches often simplify these aspects, limiting policy transparency and practical relevance. This paper. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: MOE-DGSCND: Multi-Objective Enterprise Green Supply Chain Network Design
research.summary: Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: This paper introduces and studies the Multi-Objective Enterprise Doubly-Green Supply Chain Network Design (MOE-DGSCND) problem, an extension of Multi-Objective Supply Chain Network Design. The problem studied here is a three-objective combinatorial optimization problem that simultaneously minimizes. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Measuring Longer-Horizon Leveraged ETF Performance
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Many investors hold leveraged exchange-traded funds (LETFs) for more than one day. Because these products reset leverage daily, their longer-horizon returns need not equal the stated leverage multiple times the underlying return. We explain this gap. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Pawnshops and Property-Related Crime: Lessons from Interwar Tokyo
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Using ward-level panel data for 1927 to 1935 and fixed-effects models, this study examines how pawnshops were related to property-related crime in interwar Tokyo. Accordingly, public pawnshops targeting low-income borrowers are compared with profit-oriented private pawnshops. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Persistence of Bounded Rationality in Financial Markets: An Evolutionary Game-Theoretic Model
research.summary: Announce Type: cross Abstract: Classical theory predicts that irrational traders lose money to rational traders and are eventually driven out of the market. Yet noise trading, herding, and heuristic trading persist even in highly developed markets. We model a financial. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Right Numbers, Wrong Questions: Evaluating LLMs on Underspecified Financial Queries
research.summary: Announce Type: cross Abstract: Financial assistants answer questions that sound factual but depend on what the user leaves unsaid: what a data figure measures, which product variant is meant, and the investor's situation and the rules that apply. An assistant. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Strategic Integration of Artificial Intelligence in the C-Suite: The Role of the Chief AI Officer
research.summary: Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) into corporate strategy has become critical for organizations seeking to maintain competitive advantage in the digital age. Although organizations increasingly rely on AI as a strategic and organizational resource, existing. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: The Costs of Early-career Disciplinary Pivots: Evidence from Ph.D. Admissions
research.summary: Announce Type: replace Abstract: Science often advances when researchers pivot from one discipline to another and import new ideas. However, for established researchers, such pivots are associated with fewer publications and citations. Here, we investigate pivoting at the beginning of. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
